description: Run a pricing chain: stages one after another, each stage's price feeding the next as current_price and its metadata carrying forward, your price guardrails applied once at the end from your own current_price. Stage kinds: function (a pricing function, with an optional fallback), clamp (holds the running price inside limits) and, where model stages are switched on for your workspace, llm (a prompt that lets a model adjust the price within max_change_pct, or only annotate it) and vision (the same, looking at a public https image_url, with image_consent true; it never analyses faces or emotions). Each stage reports its price in and out; a model stage also returns its annotation. Each function stage that prices is one metered call, each model stage that answers is one metered model call. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

constraints.description: Optional limits applied at the end, with your guardrails.

max_price.description: The final price is at most this.

min_price.description: The final price is at least this.

context.description: The pricing context. currency is required.

channel.description: Optional sales channel; a saved rate raises the final price once.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, e.g. USD.

current_price.description: Your current price. The guardrails measure from it; a clamp, llm or vision first stage needs it.

metadata.description: Optional context every stage sees, such as unit_cost or competitor_price.

include_explanation.description: If true, each stage and the chain explain their price.

stages.description: The stages, in order, at most 10. The fields that apply depend on kind.

constraints.description: function stage: its own min_price and max_price.

fallback_function_id.description: function stage: the fallback by UUID.

fallback_function_name.description: function stage: tried once when the function fails.

function_id.description: function stage: the pricing function by UUID. Or function_name.

function_name.description: function stage: the pricing function by name, e.g. lastprice/cost-plus. Or function_id.

image_consent.description: vision stage: required, true. You confirm you may send the image to a third-party model.

image_url.description: vision stage: a public https image. Defaults to metadata image_url.

kind.description: The stage kind. Defaults to function.

label.description: Optional name shown in the answer.

max_change_pct.description: llm and vision stages: how far an adjust may move the price, in percent. Defaults to 15.

max_over_competitor_pct.description: clamp stage: at most this percent over metadata competitor_price.

max_price.description: clamp stage: lower the price to at most this.

metadata.description: Added to the running context for this stage and every later one.

min_price.description: clamp stage: raise the price to at least this.

mode.description: llm and vision stages: adjust (the default) may move the price; annotate only describes it.

on_error.description: function, llm and vision stages: skip (the default) passes the price through; fail stops the chain.

prompt.description: llm and vision stages: the instruction. May use {{price}}, {{currency}}, {{product_type}}, {{customer_segment}}, {{geo}}, {{channel}} and {{metadata.<key>}}.

timeout_ms.description: llm and vision stages: how long to wait for the model. Defaults to 10000.

name: run_pricing_chain
